plans.idea: A left-to-right banner: logo as the opening brand mark, then the large bottle, the headline and subheadline, and the CTA at the end. All four share one vertical centre line.
The bottle fills the full height on the left. Next to it, the logo sits directly above the headline and subheadline, all left-aligned to one edge, and the CTA ends the row on the right.
Copy comes first: the headline and subheadline sit top-left with the CTA left-aligned directly beneath them. The bottle sits in the middle and the logo closes the banner on the right.
